usage.how_to_add: Add new test cases by following the existing format. Include title_a, title_b, should_cluster, reason, category, and expected_behavior.
usage.validation: All gold standard tests should pass. If any fail, it indicates a regression in the clustering algorithm.
usage.maintenance: Update this file when adding new edge cases or when algorithm behavior changes intentionally.

metadata.coverage: Core clustering scenarios including exact matches, related stories, and unrelated content
